name: Karla MTDC Restaurant
why_it_matters: MTDC Karla Holiday Resort's in-house dining 1.5km from the Karla caves parking — the government-rate AC dining option for Karla-Bhaja day-trippers + weekend stayers. Maharashtrian thali + multi-cuisine + non-veg Konkan menu. Walk-in non-residents 12.30-3pm + 7.30-10.30pm.
insider_tip: Weekend lunches Sat-Sun fill the dining hall with Mumbai-Pune day-trippers — book +91-2114-282230 ahead. Sol kadhi unlimited refill with thali. Cards + UPI; cash works.
signature_address: MTDC Karla Holiday Resort, near Karla Caves, Karla 410406, Pune district

name: Hotel Surya Karla
why_it_matters: Karla-Bhaja road family hotel 800m from the Karla caves parking, on the connector road between the two cave clusters — Maharashtrian-Konkan thali for the day-tripper base. Pure-veg default + Konkan Chicken Kolhapuri non-veg menu Fri-Sun. Bhakri + pithla + dal + rice + sweet + sol kadhi at ₹200 veg / ₹280 non-veg.
insider_tip: Karla-Bhaja day-trippers post-caves lunch 1-3pm peak; arrive 12.30 or after 3pm. Sol kadhi (kokum + coconut buttermilk) free with thali Apr-Jun. Cash + UPI; no cards.
signature_address: Karla-Bhaja Road, between Karla and Bhaja Caves parking, Karla 410406, Maval taluka, Pune district

name: Ekvira Restaurant Karla
why_it_matters: Pilgrim thali kitchen at the Karla caves temple plaza, 200m from parking — the Ekvira Devi temple-side default. Maharashtrian satvik thali at ₹120 with bhakri + 2 vegetables + dal + rice + sweet + buttermilk. The Ekvira Devi temple at Karla draws a Mahar/Devadasi-pilgrim flow that goes back centuries.
insider_tip: Ekvira-jatra full-moon Feb-Mar peak — queue starts 5am dawn. Off-jatra days quiet 12.30-2.30pm. Free filter coffee refill with thali. Cash + UPI; no cards.
signature_address: Karla Temple Plaza, near Karla Caves parking, Karla 410406, Pune district

name: Hotel Janseva Karla
why_it_matters: Karla caves approach-road pure-veg thali kitchen 500m from the parking — Maharashtrian satvik thali (no onion-garlic by default) for Ekvira-jatra pilgrim flow + Mahar-community coach groups. Bhakri + pithla + zunka + dal + rice + sweet at ₹150. Misal pav Sundays.
insider_tip: Ekvira-jatra full-moon Feb-Mar window the queue extends 1km — arrive pre-dawn or post-2pm. Sabudana khichdi on Mon + Thu vrat days. Cash + UPI only; no cards.
signature_address: Karla Caves Approach Road, Karla 410406, Pune district
